security.item: Escaped < and > in all values written into the map script so shortcode parameters cannot close the script block.
HTML-escaped kml_label and geojson_label, which the layer control renders as HTML.
map_container now accepts only class, title, data-* and aria-* attributes (no event handlers).
Removed the unused includes/geojson.php, which was web-accessible and queried a hard-coded database.

fix.item: Fixed align-left, align-center and align-right having no effect outside a grid layout; alignment now uses auto margins.
Fixed Spanish (es-ES) language files failing to parse because of a line break in the description, which made the admin fall back to English.

addition.item: Added wrap-left and wrap-right alignment: the map floats and article text wraps around it. Below 768px the map returns to full width.
Added the float clear at the end of the article text when a wrapped map is present, so the read-more link and the next blog item start below the map.
Added Align Center, Wrap Left and Wrap Right to the backend alignment list (en-GB, es-ES).
Added kml_label shortcode parameter to set the KML layer name in the layer control (default "KML Layer").
Added geojson_label shortcode parameter to set the GeoJSON layer name in the layer control (default "GeoJson Layer").

change.item: Replaced the hard-coded "Route Layer" and "Schedule Layer" layer control labels.
Updated language files (en-GB, es-ES) to 1.1.0 and added kml_label and geojson_label to the shortcode example.

fix.item: Fixed the default marker title displaying an untranslated language constant.
Fixed encoded HTML in marker popup content.
Fixed encoded line break tags so popup line breaks render correctly.
Restored initialization of the fullscreen control.
Corrected basemap names and provider attributions.

change.item: Removed the Leaflet attribution prefix while retaining provider attribution.
Marker icons consolidated in images/markers (linked in leaflet.css)

remove.item: Settings option for multiple default markers

fix.item: Asset paths corrected to load via Web Asset Manager
Resolved heredoc PHP parsing issues (<?= ... ?> replaced with variables)
Ensured marker shadow path and fitBounds with multiple markers

addition.item: Robust icon URL resolver (absolute, relative, data URIs, filenames)

change.item: Standardized media layout (stock vs custom marker directories)

security.item: Tightened CSP headers while allowing tiles, scripts, popups

fix.item: Corrected Leaflet Omnivore plugin asset loading (local copy, no CDN)

addition.item: Marker_content parameter for rich HTML popups

change.item: Improved JavaScript: safe json_encode() for popup content
Modularized JS injection (only once, even with multiple maps)

changelog.note: Clean, modular JS structure with shared color sequencing

addition.item: Two-finger scroll (potential replacement for disabling scroll_wheel zoom)

fix.item: Joomla update XML corrected (<server type="plugin"> → <server type="extension">)

addition.item: Toggle: open marker title on load

change.item: Renamed container from leaflet-map → map (removed str_replace instances)

addition.item: Basemap selection field in XML (not yet wired to PHP)

change.item: All CSS/JS moved into plugin dir
Language file names standardized to plg_system_xxx
Fieldset groups added for description and settings
Added z-index in CSS to keep menu in front of map
